_analysis.antihebb_scaling: Monotonic: alpha 0.1->0.3->0.5->0.7->1.0 maps to 48.56%->54.42%->59.82%->64.69%->70.98%. Full suppression (alpha=1.0) is best on calibrated base. This is the key finding — at D=64, maximal surround suppression in W_pos space is optimal.

_analysis.fast_W_phase_verdict: DEAD at D=64. Both tested configs 8-11pp below baseline. Same D x D interference pattern as cross-dim W_mix and phase matrix bank.
